rows.en:
(Alright, that's another week done~
What should I do this weekend...)

(Oh, it's Gary-sensei...
Right, I'll ask about his weekend plans
and get some ideas.)
Gary-sensei, do you have a minute?

Hey, it's \p!
What's up?

Well, I wanted to hear how you spend
your weekends, Sensei, to get some ideas...

Oh? Looking to me for ideas, huh? Admirable.
Alright, listen up good!

...Uh... let's see... first off...
Umm... hmm~...

Ah, that's it!
Quit yammering about dumb stuff like plans
and just do what you wanna do! Yeah, that's it!
Got it? See ya!

(Sensei... Could it be he didn't have
any plans at all...?)

(Alrighty, that's the end of another week.
What should I do this weekend...)

(Oh, Gary-sensei...
I know, I'll ask about his weekend plans
and get some ideas.)

Yes, I thought I'd ask how you spend
your weekends, Sensei, to get some ideas...
Huh? Uh, okay...
rows.notes: x2: also the female player's reply to Sheryl in nml_she_015; kept generic.

rows.en: (Sensei... Did he maybe not have any plans?)
(Next is P.E. That's Hilda-sensei's class, right?)

Alright, gather round!
Class is starting~!

Huh, Gary-sensei?
Isn't this Hilda-sensei's class...?

Yeah, Hilda's off due to unavoidable circumstances.
So today, I'll be teaching the class!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Gary calls her plain 'Hilda'.

rows.en: Now then, let's start properly...
What are you doing?
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Hilda to Gary; same wording as c05149.

rows.en: Ah... well... y'see... uh...

If you've got no business here,
then step aside.
Move.
(What was Gary-sensei even trying to do...?)
(Next is P.E., Hilda-sensei's class, right?)

Huh, Gary-sensei?
I thought this was Hilda-sensei's class...
(What was Gary-sensei trying to do, I wonder...)

(I came out to town, but now
what should I do...)

Yo, \p!
What're you doing here, hitting on girls?
Ah, youth!

No, I'm not, Gary-sensei!
What are YOU doing in a place like this?

Ah, my beloved ride's been acting up,
so I came to pick up some parts, but...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. aisha: his own vehicle, kind unspecified ('ride').

rows.en: But...?

Unfortunately the shop's closed,
so I was at my wits' end...
Oh, I see. That's too bad.

I know! You're free anyway, right?
Perfect timing. Come keep me company!
Huh, Sensei!? H-Hold on a sec~...

(He dragged me all over the place, but all in all,
it turned out to be a fun day!)

(I came out to town,
but what should I do...)

Yo, \p!
What're you doing here, hitting on guys?
Ah, youth!
rows.notes: Female scene. gyaku-nan: a girl hitting on guys (as c06815).

rows.en:
I'm NOT, Gary-sensei!
What are YOU doing in a place like this?
Oh, really? That's too bad.

(He dragged me all over the place, but all in all,
it was kind of a fun day!)
(Next up is swimming. Time to give it my all!)
Ooh, it's perfect swimming weather today!

Oh, hello, Gary-sensei... Wait,
you don't teach swimming, do you?

Hm, ah, well...
Don't sweat the details!
No, but I'm sure Hilda-sensei will...
Nah, it's fine. As for her, I'll just...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Trails off; Hilda appears.

rows.en: What's going on? What are YOU doing here?
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Hilda to Gary with the contemptuous kisama; carried by the stress on YOU.

rows.en: Ah, I figured I'd help out with your class!
Don't need it. Go home.
No, but y'see...
Go home.
(Gary-sensei really can't stand up to Hilda-sensei...)
Well, but I'm sure Hilda-sensei will...
(Gary-sensei just can't stand up to Hilda-sensei...)
(Next up is Yamashiro-sensei's class, right...?)
Good morning, class! Now, let's begin!
Huh!? Gary-sensei?

Listen up, this is health class.
You all love health class, don't you?
rows.notes: Shared male/female. hoken taiiku (health and P.E.); the joke is sex education, so 'health class'.

rows.en: ...Everyone's totally weirded out, though...
Hey, what are you doing?

Oh, you're finally here.
Alright, the baton's all yours!

Gary-sensei,
isn't it high time you stopped acting on whims?

Aw, once in a while is fine. See ya.
And you lot, take your classes seriously!

(What a teacher, causing a commotion
for nothing...)
(Okay, next is Yamashiro-sensei's class, right...?)
Hm!? Gary-sensei?
...Looks like everyone's kind of put off, though...

(Causing a commotion right before class...
What a teacher...)

uncertain: c16378: hoken taiiku rendered 'health class' to keep the sex-ed joke.
c16349: aisha (his beloved vehicle) rendered 'my beloved ride'; car or bike is not stated.
